en-US.author: Anthropic PBC
en-US.description: Interact with the Claude API directly from your terminal with the ant command-line tool
en-US.longDescription:
The ant CLI provides access to the Claude API from your terminal. Every API resource is exposed as a subcommand, with output formatting, response filtering, and support for YAML or JSON file input that make it practical for both interactive exploration and automation.
Compared to calling the API with curl, ant lets you build request bodies from typed flags or piped YAML rather than hand-written JSON, inline file contents into string fields with an @path reference, and extract fields from the response with a built-in --transform query (no separate JSON tooling required). List endpoints paginate automatically. Claude Code understands how to use ant natively.
en-US.name: Claude Platform CLI
en-US.releaseNotes:
Features
- api: add reply_mode to Claude Tag Slack channel settings
- client: read OpenTelemetry baggage from the BAGGAGE environment variable
  While tracing is on, API requests send the value of BAGGAGE in the baggage header, the same way they continue the trace in TRACEPARENT.
Bug Fixes
- auth: revoke tokens on the server at ant auth logout
- cli: stop the JSON explorer crashing in a very short terminal or on an empty list
Chores
- bump go sdk to v2.9.0
- docs: clarify plugin delete and skill name conflict descriptions
- docs: clarify when to omit user_profile_id on external keys
- docs: note that Claude Tag settings accept self-hosted runner pools
Documentation
- examples: show multiagent when creating a Managed Agents agent

zh-CN.description: 通过 ant 命令行工具直接从终端与 Claude API 交互
zh-CN.longDescription:
ant CLI 可让你通过终端访问 Claude API。每个 API 资源都以子命令的形式暴露，支持输出格式化、响应过滤，并可使用 YAML 或 JSON 文件输入，适用于交互式探索和自动化操作。
与使用 curl 调用 API 相比，ant 允许你通过类型化的标志或管道传入的 YAML 来构建请求体，而无需手动编写 JSON；通过 @path 引用将文件内容内联到字符串字段中；并使用内置的 --transform 查询从响应中提取字段（无需额外的 JSON 工具）。列表接口会自动分页。Claude Code 能够原生理解如何使用 ant。
